intent: Map the overgoal pivot from ZCode to ZBill (Windows-first bill-report app): locate prior ZBill work, port its product bits onto main, verify the product-mode seams, and bound the cut/extend waves so milestone routing and native planning rest on verified seams and owner-confirmed scope.
flow: ZBill product mode rides build-time define (__ZBILL_PRODUCT__) into packages/shared env const consumed by packages/ui sidebar; bill pipeline lives in self-contained zbill-billing/ (Python venv, fixtures, xlsx+PDF); cut candidates are packages/ui purchase/marketplace/automations surfaces (wave 1) and remote-connection/data-sync/web-server remote-control modules (wave 2); the agent core (session runtime, protocol, host, 3-panel shell, document panel) is kept.
scope_rationale: Milestone route: whole-product pivot across five UI/service modules plus a Python pipeline, with hard deletions touching many packages; exceeds normal planning depth. Deep per-wave import-graph mapping is deliberately deferred to per-wave investigations executed before each maker wave, per milestone-slice reassessment.
unknowns: Full import graph per cut wave (per-wave investigations produce the exact keep-list)
Which provider modules the local agent runtime requires for model access vs purchasable UI (wave-1 investigation)
Document-panel archive UX shape for report history (bill-feature wave)

conventions.rule: Components access services through hooks in src/hooks; components never take services or repos directly
conventions.scope: All new/changed UI wiring including item review and archive surfaces
conventions.plan_application: Review/edit and archive UI goes through hooks/store; no component-local service calls

conventions.rule: Zustand state in src/store with a single owner per state; no duplicate write paths
conventions.scope: Report archive index and item-edit draft state
conventions.plan_application: One owner for archived-report index; edits persist via the pipeline's items.json contract

conventions.rule: Deleted behavior must keep typecheck/lint/architecture checks green and docs updated in the same change
conventions.plan_application: Each wave is one verified slice: code removal + route removal + doc update + checks, no dead exports left (knip)
